  brb_map:     "agent/brb_species_map.csv"                                               # BRB name -> accession (B73 flag)
  skim_checks: "data/rtiger_50K/calls_checks_common_schema.csv"                          # Skim-RTI checks (B73, Purple)
  molb_calls:  "results/sim_calibration/gbts_calls/SNP_wsfilt/calls_common_schema.csv"   # MolB-RTI (B73-bulk)

**Repo:** [sawers-rellan-labs/zealtiger](https://github.com/sawers-rellan-labs/zealtiger)

A **B73 control** must be a *pure recurrent-parent* rep — **no introgression** (≈ 0 donor
genome-wide). This doc tracks **every B73 rep across the three experiments** (BrB-seq,
SNP50K skim, MolBreeding GBTS), scores each rep's donor content from its own caller, and
flags reps that are **not actually clean B73** (localized donor on a chromosome →
mislabel / contamination / real introgression). It exists because the BrB-seq B73 control
`PN1_SID15` turned out to be an impostor (a chromosome arm reads ~50% donor).

- **donor dosage** = genome-wide donor-allele fraction (`Σ len·state/2 / Σ len`, state REF=0/HET=1/ALT=2); 0 = pure B73.
- **maxchr** = the worst single-chromosome donor fraction — localizes an introgressed arm.
- **flag**: `clean` (dosage < 0.02), `borderline` (0.02–0.10), **`impostor`** (> 0.10).

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse); library(ggpubr)
pal <- c(REF = "gold", HET = "springgreen4", ALT = "purple4")

brbmap <- read_csv(params$brb_map, show_col_types = FALSE)
brb_b73 <- brbmap$name[grepl("^B73", brbmap$accession)]
calls <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(params$brb_calls,  show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(name %in% brb_b73) %>%
    mutate(exp = "BrB-RTI (r=7, wideseq)"),
  read_csv(params$skim_checks, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(donor == "B73") %>%
    mutate(exp = "Skim-RTI (r=5)"),
  read_csv(params$molb_calls,  show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(donor == "B73-bulk") %>%
    mutate(exp = "MolB-RTI (r=2)")
) %>% select(exp, name, chr, start_bp, end_bp, state)

qc <- calls %>% mutate(l = end_bp - start_bp + 1) %>%
  group_by(exp, name) %>%
  summarise(dosage = sum(l * state / 2) / sum(l),
            maxchr = max(tapply(l * state / 2, chr, sum) / tapply(l, chr, sum)),
            worst_chr = paste0("chr", names(which.max(tapply(l * state / 2, chr, sum) / tapply(l, chr, sum)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(flag = case_when(dosage > 0.10 ~ "impostor", dosage > 0.02 ~ "borderline", TRUE ~ "clean")) %>%
  arrange(desc(dosage))
cat(sprintf("B73 reps: %d (BrB %d, Skim %d, MolB %d) | clean %d | borderline %d | impostor %d\n",
            nrow(qc), sum(qc$exp == "BrB-RTI (r=7, wideseq)"), sum(qc$exp == "Skim-RTI (r=5)"),
            sum(qc$exp == "MolB-RTI (r=2)"),
            sum(qc$flag == "clean"), sum(qc$flag == "borderline"), sum(qc$flag == "impostor")))
```

## Per-rep donor content (all experiments, worst → best)

```{r table}
qc %>% transmute(experiment = exp, sample = name, dosage = round(dosage, 3),
                 maxchr = round(maxchr, 3), worst_chr, flag) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Every B73 rep, by donor dosage. `impostor` = not pure B73 (a chromosome carries donor).")
```

**Read:** the `impostor` reps carry **localized** donor (high `maxchr` on one chromosome) —
the signature of a real introgressed segment, not diffuse noise — so they are mislabeled /
contaminated samples, not B73. The BrB-seq impostors cluster on plate PN1.

## Chromosome painting — worst vs clean B73 *within* each experiment

A global 5-worst/5-best split is uninformative: **every impostor is BrB-seq and every
cleanest is Skim/MolB**. So this paints the **5 worst and 5 cleanest B73 reps within each of
BrB-seq and Skim** — showing that BrB-seq *does* have clean reps (usable controls) and what
Skim's *dirtiest* reps look like (still essentially all-REF). (MolB has only 2 reps, both clean.)

```{r painting, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
exps  <- c("BrB-RTI (r=7, wideseq)", "Skim-RTI (r=5)")
short <- function(e) ifelse(grepl("BrB", e), "BrB-seq", "Skim")
sel <- qc %>% filter(exp %in% exps) %>% group_by(exp) %>%
  mutate(rw = row_number(desc(dosage)), rc = row_number(dosage)) %>%
  filter(rw <= 5 | rc <= 5) %>% mutate(grp = if_else(rw <= 5, "WORST", "clean")) %>% ungroup()
lab <- function(e, g, n, d) sprintf("%s %s<br>%s<br>%.3f", short(e), g, n, d)
ttb <- sel %>% mutate(eo = match(exp, exps), go = match(grp, c("WORST", "clean"))) %>%
  arrange(eo, go, desc(dosage)) %>% transmute(row = lab(exp, grp, name, dosage)) %>% pull(row)
paint <- calls %>% inner_join(sel %>% select(exp, name, dosage, grp), by = c("exp", "name")) %>%
  mutate(row = factor(lab(exp, grp, name, dosage), levels = rev(ttb)),
         state = factor(state, 0:2, c("REF", "HET", "ALT")),
         chr = factor(chr, levels = 1:10, labels = paste0("chr", 1:10)))

ggplot(paint, aes(xmin = start_bp/1e6, xmax = end_bp/1e6, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = state)) +
  geom_rect() +
  facet_grid(row ~ chr, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::unit_format(unit = "", scale = 1)) +
  labs(title = "B73 reps — 5 worst vs 5 cleanest within BrB-seq and within Skim",
       subtitle = "row = experiment / sample / donor dosage | gold REF, green HET, purple ALT — a clean B73 is all gold",
       x = "Position (Mb)", fill = "Genotype") +
  ggpubr::theme_classic2(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y.left = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 8, lineheight = 0.85),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "lines"), panel.spacing.y = unit(0.15, "lines"),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6))
```

## Recommended clean controls

```{r controls}
qc %>% filter(flag == "clean") %>% group_by(exp) %>% slice_min(dosage, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(experiment = exp, sample = name, dosage = round(dosage, 4), maxchr = round(maxchr, 4)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Cleanest 3 B73 reps per experiment — use one of these as the control (NOT PN1_SID15).")
```

**Use:** for the BrB-RTI comparison docs, replace the `PN1_SID15` control with the cleanest
BrB-seq rep above. The `impostor` reps should be excluded from any B73-check pooling and
flagged for the BRB-seq relabeling follow-up (`docs/brbseq-sample-mislabeling.md`).
